title_en: Chinese History (18/20): The Four Great Inventions of Ancient China
note_en: 经由 means "by way of" and names the route something travels along: 这四项发明后来经由丝绸之路等途径传入世界各地 "these four inventions later spread around the world by way of the Silk Road and other routes." Unlike English, where "via the Silk Road" can come at the end, the 经由 phrase must come before the verb (传入). The text uses it again for the compass: one account says the European-style compass reached China 经由日本海盗 "by way of Japanese pirates."
